verdict.rationale: Graphite's AI reviewer runs automatically on every new PR in the selected repos (graphite-docs-4, graphite-docs-19). Custom rules let teams give Graphite Agent explicit guidelines to follow during review (graphite-docs-5), and customizations are a listed plan feature (graphite-docs-33). That covers the core idea of user-defined agentic review criteria, but the evidence frames these as review guidelines that produce comments, not as discrete pre-merge checks that pass or fail and gate merging. Missing for 10: evidence that rules surface as pass/fail checks or block merges, explicit confirmation that rules are written in free-form plain language (e.g. 'docs updated', 'tests cover new paths'), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
